name: Ahmad Zulkifli
bio:
Ahmad discovered his passion for motorsport during his university days, volunteering at local racing events as a mechanical assistant. His keen eye for detail and natural aptitude for working with composite materials quickly shone through. After graduating with a degree in mechanical engineering, he secured a role at a smaller racing outfit before being headhunted by Toyota Gazoo Racing BR.

Ahmad's approach to composite technology is rooted in a deep understanding of material science and a relentless pursuit of perfection. He believes that meticulous preparation and constant experimentation are key to unlocking the full potential of composites in racing. His innovative spirit and pragmatic problem-solving skills make him a valuable asset to the team.

What sets Ahmad apart is his ability to blend theoretical knowledge with hands-on experience. He's not afraid to get his hands dirty and often spends hours in the workshop, experimenting with different techniques and materials to improve performance and durability.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight fade
physical.description: Ahmad has a lean build and a focused gaze, reflecting his meticulous nature.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas and observations.
Insists on using a specific brand of epoxy resin for all composite repairs.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on the workbench when deep in thought.
